subject: Report counters
notes: 'LINE-COUNTER shall not be referenced as a receiving operand.' Screened at the ONE receiving chokepoint, one line above the PAGE-COUNTER place SR1 admits, so the rule's two halves - which counter is admitted and which is not - are written down side by side and cannot drift. Measured across every verb the chokepoint serves: MOVE, ADD TO, COMPUTE, INSPECT TALLYING, ACCEPT, INITIALIZE and UNSTRING TALLYING IN all refuse LINE-COUNTER while the same statements accept PAGE-COUNTER. The refusal also LEFT the COBOL0899 'recognized but not implemented' band for its own code, COBOL2197 (kb/Work PB429): a rule-rejection wearing an unimplemented-feature code tells the reader their legal program is unsupported when their program is illegal.
